en.headline: 14 own commits plus 15 automated commits across three repositories
en.summary: **14 own commits** were made across `sogeisetsu/opencode-agent-sandbox` and `sogeisetsu/pixel-logo-toolkit`, plus 15 automated commits by `github-actions[bot]` in `sogeisetsu/sogeisetsu`. In `sogeisetsu/opencode-agent-sandbox`, 12 commits added Hunyuan 4 pelican-bike testing notes and four-version comparisons, archived evaluation artifacts and prompt text, and clarified that `AGENTS.md` is the single agreed location for agent conventions. They also revised knowledge wording to remove conversational self-reflection and first-person phrasing, corrected the LSP description against the official migration guide, documented the `experimental.todo` switch and evidence that LSP runtime features are not implemented, and explained that `browser` is a namespace. Further updates rewrote the built-in tool list for the V1/V2 documents, added criteria for `enhance-prompt`, indexed the knowledge directory, and recorded the desktop harness list with OpenCode V2 comment and tool comparisons. The repository also began ignoring the `.workbuddy` project data directory. In `sogeisetsu/pixel-logo-toolkit`, 2 commits upgraded the gallery into a GitHub Pages homepage with bilingual, light/dark, and copy-command features driven by Markdown, and added 12 Xiaohongshu-style covers plus a browsable gallery page. No pull requests, issues, reviews, releases, or discussions were recorded.

zh.headline: 14 次本人提交，另有 15 次自动提交，分布在三个仓库
zh.summary: **14 次本人提交**分布于 `sogeisetsu/opencode-agent-sandbox` 和 `sogeisetsu/pixel-logo-toolkit`，另有 15 次由 `github-actions[bot]` 在 `sogeisetsu/sogeisetsu` 自动提交。`sogeisetsu/opencode-agent-sandbox` 的 12 次提交新增混元 4 版鹈鹕骑车实测与四版对比，归档评测产物和提示词原文，并明确 `AGENTS.md` 是约定唯一的落点。相关知识文档去除了对话式自省与第一人称表述，按官方迁移指南改正 LSP 口径，补充 `experimental.todo` 开关、LSP 运行时未实现的源码证据，并说明 `browser` 是命名空间。后续提交按 V1/V2 双文档重写内置工具清单，补充 `enhance-prompt` 的形态判据，更新目录索引，并收录桌面 harness 清单与 OpenCode V2 评论和工具对照；仓库同时开始忽略 `.workbuddy` 项目数据目录。`sogeisetsu/pixel-logo-toolkit` 的 2 次提交将画廊升级为 GitHub Pages 首页，提供双语、明暗主题和复制命令，内容改由 Markdown 驱动，并新增 12 张小红书风格封面与可浏览画廊页面。当天没有 pull request、issue、review、release 或讨论记录。
